title: UNIP: Rethinking Pre-trained Attention Patterns for Infrared Semantic Segmentation

layout.note: Two tinted bands side by side at the top (Step1 green, Step2 yellow) over one full-width peach band (Step3) that holds two grey framed boxes, Pre-training and Fine-tuning; coloured arrows run from Step 2 and Step 1 down into Step 3.

lesson: Turn the paper's structure into a chain of thought: tinted bands titled by research questions, with each insight given one colour that follows its text, its labelled arrow and the method component it inspires, so the reader sees which finding motivates which design choice.
